SELECT f.id, f.kind, f.original_name, f.path, f.thumb_path, f.width, f.height, f.uploaded_at, f.exif_datetime, f.exif_make, f.exif_model, f.exif_orientation, f.exif_json, f.exif_search, f.crop_x, f.crop_y, f.crop_w, f.crop_h, f.group_id, g.name AS group_name FROM media_files f LEFT JOIN media_groups g ON g.id = f.group_id WHERE f.id = #{id}
